name: character-modern-player-walk
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PIXEL ART CHARACTER WALK SPRITE SHEET, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, no gutters, 1024x1024. One identical small adult character in every cell, consistent scale and feet baseline, tiny game character with 24-pixel-tall body when reduced. Crisp true 16-bit pixel clusters, shaded clothing, expressive readable silhouette, no smooth painting, no shadows or background, no text or borders. Rows: row 1 faces DOWN/south, row 2 faces LEFT/west, row 3 faces RIGHT/east, row 4 faces UP/north/back. Within each row, 4 distinct sequential walking poses: left foot forward + right arm forward, passing pose, right foot forward + left arm forward, opposite passing pose. Every pose is the SAME identity, proportions, clothing and camera. Real alternating legs and counter-swing arms, subtle weight transfer, constant head size. Orthographic overhead RPG perspective, never isometric, no diagonal facing. Center each character inside its cell, generous transparent padding, feet at identical baseline. No extra characters or objects. Modern 2020s clothing, no historical costume.
A stylish slender adult VAMPIRE: pale face, short dark hair, charcoal bomber jacket with burgundy hood lining, black slim jeans, dark sneakers, subtle crimson eyes. A cool mysterious modern person, no cape, no top hat, no Victorian suit, no weapons.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: Produce a true WALK CYCLE. The old side-facing frames all had the exact same wide stride and look like skating. The middle frames MUST have FEET TOGETHER, with one knee bent and heel lifted, narrow vertical leg silhouette. Four columns must alternate WIDE STRIDE / FEET TOGETHER / OPPOSITE WIDE STRIDE / FEET TOGETHER with opposite knee raised. When facing left/right, column 1 and 3 have distinctly opposite arms forward and opposite bright/dark leg forward; columns 2 and 4 have legs almost overlapping. Make arm swing different too. Four equally spaced cells per row, fully transparent blank background, all feet on same baseline. Do not simply repeat the wide stride in all frames. Preserve this character's design and 4 directional rows. This is a functional animation atlas, not a collection of variations.
